name: scan-and-propose-fixes
description: Run an assurance scan against the current project, then propose fixes for any gaps. The most common starting workflow.
prompt:
Use the `assurance-scan` MCP server to scan this project. Do NOT try to start any server or install Python packages — the service is already running.

Steps:
1. Call `load_fr_catalog` with `fr_catalog_path="./fr-catalog.json"` to confirm the catalogue is well-formed.
2. Call `start_scan` with `fr_catalog_path="./fr-catalog.json"` and (if present) `mapping_pack_path="./evidence-mapping-pack.json"`.
3. Poll `get_scan_status` with the returned `run_id` until `status == "completed"` (expect ~90 seconds).
4. Call `get_findings` and `get_gap_analysis` for the same `run_id`.
5. Read the relevant source files (using your own Read/Grep tools) and propose a table of fixes grouped by theme.

Do NOT apply fixes yet — wait for my approval. After approval, apply the fixes, then call `start_scan` again to verify the gaps closed.
